newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's ICO finalises euro debt convertible plan.
newsitem.headline: Spain's ICO finalises euro debt convertible plan.

text.p: Spain's Official Credit Institute (ICO) said on Monday that it was finalising plans to buy back old debt and substitute them with new issues of euro-convertible debt.
The first such operation in Spain is designed to substitute heterogeneous issues of low liquidity for a single reference of higher volume, ICO said.
"The operation will be tied to a new programme of successive peseta issues, which can be converted into euros in the near future," ICO said in a statement.
The first auction of the new issue will take place before the end of the year.
The buy-back operation is supervised by the Spanish stock market commission CNMV.
